title: Quantinuum Helix: [[20,2,6]] C4-Helix code on Helios, logical Clifford error 2.8e-4 (4.28x below physical), 10 ions per logical qubit
summary: Preprint arXiv:2609.03194 (Berthusen et al., submitted 2026-09-02, announced 2026-09-08) validates the Helix compact fault-tolerant architecture on the 98-qubit Helios: [[20,2,6]] code (10 physical ions per logical qubit at distance 6), logical memory 4.6e-5 per logical qubit per cycle with no post-selection, logical Clifford gates at 2.8e-4 per gate (4.28x cleaner than the physical gates), and entanglement between two different codes.

key_specs.logical_memory_error: 4.6e-5 per logical qubit per cycle, no post-selection

actionable: Frontier number for logical-gate fidelity at distance 6 on a commercial trapped-ion machine. Helios is this project's designated hardware anchor (HYP-013 platform). Does not change HYP-029, which is conditional on the withdrawn alpha input (ERRATA D8). Numbers taken from a secondary report of the preprint (quantum-brief.com, 2026-09-11); the preprint itself was not read.
